Definition: from G2596 and G3129; to learn thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to note carefully:--consider.
BiblicalUsage: Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow, for they toil not, neither do they spin.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a flower that never worries is a better teacher than a sermon on anxiety.
